# Total active Grand Protectorates (all oe_cel_grand_duhu subjects).
oe_cel3_total_duhu_val = {
	value = 0
	every_subject = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
		}
		add = 1
	}
}
